items.title: Kalshi traders think the bitcoin rally could end the year near current levels
items.summary: Bitcoin's more than 20% rally this week has sent the cryptocurrency to heights it hasn't seen since May, but traders on prediction market platform Kalshi see it ending 2026 near current levels.

items.title: Trump admin taps former JPMorgan Chase exec Matt Zames to advise Social Security agency
items.summary: Former JPMorgan Chase executive Matt Zames will join the Trump administration as an advisor to the Social Security agency, CNBC has learned.

items.title: Samsung plans up to $80 billion in shareholder returns after SK Hynix buyback
items.summary: Samsung Electronics has announced a shareholder return package, marking a blockbuster week for shareholder returns among South Korea's chip giants following SK Hynix's share buyback.

items.title: Labubu maker Pop Mart shares fall as key ex-China sales data drop, Citi cuts price target
items.summary: Shares of Pop Mart fell over 4% in Hong Kong on Friday after the Labubu maker reported first-half results that showed declining sales in Asia-Pacific and the Americas.

items.title: Chinese humanoid robots' biggest obstacle: Humans are still (mostly) better
items.summary: BEIJING — The big challenge for humanoid robots is still getting the technology to work well, according to industry leaders speaking alongside the World Robot Conference in Beijing this week.

items.title: Bessent's bond gambit aimed at calming markets is instead stirring inflation worries
items.summary: Investors over the past several days have priced in a likelihood of higher inflation ahead, a potential sign that the Treasury Department's efforts this week to improve liquidity in the government debt market are raising concerns over broader policy implications.

items.title: Bessent's efforts in the Treasury market so far haven't worked. Here's what else he can try
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent insisted Thursday that he has multiple weapons at his disposal to quell liquidity problems in the government debt market and restore calm.

items.title: Bessent says there's a 'very good chance' U.S. budget deficit under Trump has peaked
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Thursday there's a "very good chance" that the U.S. budget deficit under President Donald Trump has likely peaked.

items.title: Here are three key takeaways from the disappointing July jobs report
items.summary: Nonfarm payrolls in the U.S. unexpectedly declined in July, but so did the unemployment rate, leaving investors with mixed signals on how to process the latest jobs report.
